newsitem.title: UGANDA: Six dead, 40 wounded in Uganda grenade blasts.
newsitem.headline: Six dead, 40 wounded in Uganda grenade blasts.

text.p: Six people were killed and about 40 wounded in the Ugandan capital Kampala when unidentified men tossed grenades into a crowd, state-run Radio Uganda reported on Thursday.
The blasts took place around 8 p.m. on Wednesday in Kibuye suburb.
Car passengers threw a grenade at a commuter taxi and a second one at a following police car, which both missed, witnesses told the independent Monitor newspaper.
A grenade was then thrown at a crowd that gathered nearby, killing six and wounding around 40, the radio said. Two policemen were among the wounded, the paper said. The motive was not known.
